To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of explicit, declarative knowledge is essential for the efficient processing of image sequences of cells, and that this can be achieved by the use of a query language.
query-based visual analysis is an effective way to process image sequences of moving and dividing cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a computer vision system which can process raw image sequences of cells and respond to user queries about the cells' behaviour.
the design of a system which can respond to queries about the spatio-temporal structure of a sequence of images of cells.
how to build a computer vision system that will be useful to biologists.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of query-based visual analysis is an effective means of controlling and managing the processing of raw image sequences.
query-based processing is essential for visual analysis of raw images of moving cells.
query-based processing allows a visual analysis system to adapt to the user's requirements.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed the basic concepts of a system that can be used to analyse raw image sequence data from a microscope and we have implemented two systems, one using simple rules and the other real data, to test these concepts.
it has shown that it is possible to use a query based approach for visual analysis of cell image sequences and to use this approach in a way that allows adaptive control of processing.
it has shown that it is possible to develop a visual reasoning system for the analysis of image sequences of moving cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of a query based approach is a powerful way of managing the complexity of image sequence analysis.
the use of explicit knowledge in a query-based visual analysis system is an effective way to manage the computational expense of processing raw image sequences.

the visual analysis of raw image sequences is not just a matter of applying a series of processing steps in the correct order, it is a matter of applying processing steps that are appropriate to the current state of the data.
